When he brought her home, she smiled at the bottle. “I threw it from the ship,” she said. “I believed your light could guide my words to someone.” Elias looked back at the lamp, still burning through the morning mist, and felt that it had finally answered.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市尚未完全醒来。高架桥上的路灯一盏盏延伸，像疲倦却固执的星河。便利店的白光落在空荡的街口，环卫车缓慢转过弯，水花轻响。远处第一班地铁穿过地底，楼宇的窗仍暗着，只有医院的灯彻夜未熄。风从江边吹来，带着潮湿的夜气。早餐铺揭开蒸笼，白雾升起，一个赶路的人呵暖双手。天色将明未明，城市在寂静里轻轻换气，等待人群再次涌入它的脉搏。","w03":"• Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n• It always needs a stopping rule, called the base case, so it does not go on forever.\n• Imagine opening nested boxes: you open one, repeat with the box inside, and stop when you find the prize."}
